bibliographic-data.invention-title: SYSTEME UND VERFAHREN ZUR CHROMATOGRAFIE UND REGENERIERUNG
SYSTÈMES ET PROCÉDÉS D'UTILISATION ET DE RÉGÉNÉRATION DE CHROMATOGRAPHIE
SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR CHROMATOGRAPHY USE AND REGENERATION

abstract.p: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to a method of regenerating a hydrophobic interaction chromatography column to which a load mass has been applied, the method comprising passing one or more column volumes of an alkaline solution through hydrophobic interaction media within the column, wherein the alkaline solution includes a total dissolved salt concentration of 0.1 mM to 50 mM, wherein material bound to the hydrophobic interaction media is removed.
